---
title: "R plotting smoke test"
engine: knitr
---

This ggplot2 plot is computed during rendering, with no external data.

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-parabola
#| fig-cap: "A parabola generated by R and ggplot2."
#| fig-alt: "An orange upward-opening parabola with its minimum at the origin."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
library(ggplot2)

x <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 200)
points <- data.frame(x = x, y = x^2)
ggplot(points, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#c2410c", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "R: parabola", x = "x", y = expression(x^2)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
